UCFL.notes: Tamchy / Ysyk-Kul (UCFL/IKU), USD. New record, 18 Nov 2026. Single source: FCG OPS quote 129033 (17 Nov 2026; A6-AFO E35L 24.3 t, arrival from UCFM 23 Nov 05:45 UTC and departure to OMDW 09:10 UTC, 4 pax each way, 3,176.74 EUR). The 20 lines reconcile to the cent and confirm FCG disbursement 11% on everything except supervision (2,411.48 x 11% = 265.26). Quoted in EUR at 1 EUR = 1.0673 USD, the same rate as the FCG UCFM quote of the same day; the airport items converted at that rate recover the Kyrgyz USD tariff: landing 18 + 2% = 18.36 per ton, terminal navigation 6.12 per ton, en-route 45.90 per 100 km, follow-me 21.42, GPU 48.96 per 15 min, airport ramp 399.84 + marshalling 18.36 = handling 418.20, departing pax 13.46 + 11.02 + 20.41 = 44.88. FCG's own fees are in EUR and converted at the panel rate 1.1215: supervision 500 EUR = 560.75. FCG rounds MTOW up to whole tons (CL60 22, E35L 25, GLF4 34, GL5T 44, GLEX 46, GL7T 53); landing, parking, flight safety, navigation and both night rows are entered on that. Parking 15% of landing per started day, first 3 h free (quote says 3:15, safe side). Aircraft security 33% of landing per started day. Navigation row = en-route 45.90 (one 100 km unit on this short domestic leg) + 6.12 per ton + follow-me 21.42; the quote gives one en-route rate and no weight band, so GL7T may be understated. VIP lounge 116.28 per pax, both arrival and departure on this quote. Night surcharges from the quote's remarks: landing 9.5% per movement (Mar-Sep 19:30-06:00 LT, Oct-Feb 18:00-07:30 LT, 19% if both movements fall in the period) and terminal navigation 20% (22:00-06:00 LT); in the panel on the safe side all year 18:00-08:00 and 22:00-06:00. Landing permit: only a 50% surcharge for an urgent request or correction is quoted, no base price, row left empty. Children 2-12 pay 50% of passenger handling and terminal charges, under 2 exempt. The quote's 'Other Services 2% sales tax' line of 5.31 EUR could not be traced to the items it is levied on, so no row was opened. The GPU row is per hour while the quote charged 15 min. Handling 418.20 entered in all groups: the quote prices ramp charge and marshalling per occurrence with no weight band. Service list copied from UCFM by user decision so that further handlers drop straight in; everything else comes from this quote only. Time zone Asia/Bishkek set on 19 Nov 2026 so that the night surcharge rows work. K-GENERATION added as a second handler on 19 Nov 2026 from three documents for the same flight (T7-KBI CL60 21.863 t, UCFM-UCFL-OMDB, 19 Feb 2026, arrival 07:44 departure 10:25, 2 passengers), confirmed by the user as UCFL: airport act AUP02300 of 19 Feb 2026, airport invoice AUP00455 of the same date, and K-Generation invoice 9207 of 04 Mar 2026. The chain reconciles to the cent: the act's nine lines total 1,030.00 (90,073.50 KGS at 87.45), plus 2 per cent sales tax 1,050.60; the airport invoice adds the VIP lounge 91.20 and an agency service 350.00 with 12 per cent VAT and 2 per cent sales tax, 399.00, giving 1,540.80; K-Generation then bills handling 1,449.60 (1,050.60 + 399.00), passenger handling 91.20, catering 630.42, disbursement 130.27, supervision 200.00 and catering arrangement 50.00, total 2,551.49. The disbursement is exactly 6 per cent of handling plus passenger handling plus catering, which matches the 6 per cent carried for this handler at UCFM; supervision and the catering arrangement stay outside the base. Airport lines are entered gross, including the 2 per cent sales tax, the same convention as K-Generation at UCFM: landing 21.863 t x 18.00 = 394.00 becomes 401.88, flight safety 33 per cent of landing becomes 132.60, the departing passenger charges (servicing 13.20, terminal use 10.80, electronic check-in 2.40, airport dues 20.00 = 46.40) become 47.33 per pax, individual transport for crew 45.00 becomes 45.90, and aircraft receiving and its departure 18.00 becomes 18.36 in the Handling Fee row. Agency services 399.00 is entered with the VAT and sales tax included, since that is the amount K-Generation passes on. The VIP lounge 91.20 for 2 passengers is 45.60 per passenger; the invoice does not say which direction, so it is entered on departure. The act's apron service 350.00 is carried inside the Handling Fee row by user decision of 19 Nov 2026: 357.00 gross with the 2 per cent sales tax, on top of the 18.36 aircraft receiving, so the row is 375.36 and the panel matches this invoice for the same flight. Only the CL60 group is filled; the documents cover one aircraft and the other groups stay empty until a further document. Catering and the catering arrangement fee are not entered, as at every other airport. No parking was charged for the 2 h 41 min on the ground. A second set of three documents for the same handler was processed on 19 Nov 2026, confirmed by the user as GL5T although the documents label the aircraft GLEX: K-Generation invoice 9671 of 15 May 2026, airport invoice 000000664 and act AUP05415, both of 30 Apr 2026, for A6-AFE 43.545 t, UCFM-UCFL-HECA, arrival 02:28 departure 14:33, 9 passengers. The act rounds each of its eleven lines to whole dollars and totals 2,119.00 (185,262.69 KGS at 87.4293), plus 2 per cent sales tax 2,161.38; the airport invoice adds trash removal 20.00, transfer and hotel reservations 380.00 and an agency block of 390.00 (agency service 350.00, 10 per cent on the transfer and hotel 38.00, 10 per cent on the trash removal 2.00) with 12 per cent VAT and 2 per cent sales tax, 444.60, giving 3,005.98; K-Generation then bills that plus catering 679.84, disbursement 221.15, supervision 200.00 and catering arrangement 50.00, total 4,156.97. The disbursement is again exactly 6 per cent of handling plus catering. Spreading the agency block pro rata gives agency services 399.00, the same figure as the February flight, trash removal 22.28 and transfer and hotel 423.32. The GL5T group is entered gross on this act: landing 43.545 t x 18.00 = 784.00 becomes 799.68; the single night movement at 9.5 per cent is entered as 75.97 on both the arrival and the departure row; flight safety 33 per cent 259.00 becomes 264.18; excess normative parking 15 per cent 118.00 becomes 120.36 per started 24 h with no free allowance, because the documents state none; individual transport for crew 45.00 becomes 45.90 per vehicle, the act charging two; the departing passenger charges 46.40 become 47.33 per passenger; and aircraft receiving 26.00 with apron service 350.00 becomes 383.52 in the Handling Fee row. Aircraft receiving rose from 18.00 in February to 26.00 in April, and the CL60 group keeps its own document's 18.00 by user decision. Trash removal 22.28 is entered; the transfer and hotel pass-through is not, being a variable cost, and neither is catering. Excluding those, the panel runs 0.11 above this invoice, the difference coming from the act's whole-dollar rounding. This act carries no navigation, follow-me, security or VIP lounge line, so those rows stay empty in GL5T. K-Generation's type was set to FLIGHT SUPPORT on 19 Nov 2026 by user decision.
UCFL.verified: K-Generation invoices on two flights, both exact. 9207 (04 Mar 2026; T7-KBI CL60 21.863 t, 19 Feb 2026, 2 pax) with airport invoice AUP00455 and act AUP02300; 9671 (15 May 2026; A6-AFE GL5T 43.545 t, 30 Apr 2026, 9 pax) with airport invoice 000000664 and act AUP05415. Excl. catering, the catering arrangement fee and the transfer and hotel pass-through, the panel is 0.11 above the April flight, the difference coming from the act's whole-dollar line rounding. Disbursement 6% confirmed on both. FCG OPS is from quote 129033 (17 Nov 2026), not yet invoiced.

LIEO.notes: SKY SERVICES (Olbia), EUR, invoices to Falcon Flight Support. Source: invoice 1.138 (30 Jun 2026; P4-OWN E135 25 t, LSGG–LIEO–LYBA, 27.06 18:30 – 28.06 15:00 local, 'parking hrs 18', 6 adults + 2 children). Airport fees 1,217.03: landing and departure separately, 7.38 per ton (25 t × 7.38 = 184.50; June). Pax fees adult 53.98, child 50% 26.99; security 21.88, security bag charge 12.11, additional pax fees 10 (per pax incl. children); direction not on invoice, entered per departing pax (user; check with other invoices). Parking 118.25 for 18 h (6.57 per h). Commissione (administrative fee) 3.5% of airport fees → disbursement 3.5% airport. Handling services: standard handling 721.01 (OWN only), dedicated Sky agent 3 h 250 (supervision, in basket), disbursement fee 210, invoice processing 10, supplier stamp 2, waste disposal 16 in basket (all groups); over 6 hrs stay (day time or night stop) 60, automatic when stay exceeds 6 h, in basket. Catering, dish washing, storage, ice not entered. SECOND INVOICE 1.684 (31 Jul 2026; A6-FLH G450 34 t, LOWG–LIEO–LTBA, 24.07 21:11 – 25.07 15:02 local, 'parking hrs 16', 7 adults): landing = departure 360.64 (10.607 per t); pax fee 63.51, security 25.75, security bag 14.25 (all 17.65% higher than 1.138; may be a July tariff increase), additional 10; parking 109.82 (16 h × 6.86); administrative fee 3.5%; standard handling overnight 1,052.30 + extra EU surcharge 154.48 (14.68%); lavatory cleaning 215; terminal operating extension 400; folder meteo 96; disbursement fee 395; agent 250; over 6 hrs 60; invoice processing 10; supplier stamp 2 + stamp duty 2 (Italian 'bolli': 2 € stamp duty on VAT-free invoices); taxi 15, storage, dish washing, laundry, catering not entered; 22% VAT on administrative fee (panel excl. VAT). USER DECISIONS (safe side, to be reassessed with other invoices): landing and departure July tariff 10.607 per t (started ton) for all groups; pax fees July amounts (child 31.76); parking first 2 h free (1.138: 20.5 h stay → 18 h, 1.684: 17.85 h → 16 h), then every started hour ALX1·KBI, OWN, FLH 6.86, ALEX 8.47, ELL 9.28, AFZ 10.69 (by ton ratio); FLH handling 1,052.30; disbursement fee 395 in all groups (no rate found for 210 / 395: airport fees, handling, catering, total tried; may be weight band or tariff increase); lavatory 215 in basket; stamp duty 2 under airport fees, without administrative fee (user); extra EU surcharge (14.68% of handling; not charged on 1.138 LSGG→LYBA, rule unclear) in Surcharge; terminal operating extension 400 and folder meteo 96 tick. THIRD INVOICE 1.395 (15 Jul 2026; A6-AFC GLEX 46 t, TAXI flight, OMDW–LIEO–LIRA, 03.07 18:10 – 04.07 16:20 local, 'parking hrs 20', no pax): landing = departure 276.08 (6.00 per t, possibly TAXI tariff), parking 20 h × 13.80 = 276, administrative fee 3% (24.84), standard handling 1,516.85, push back 2 × 250, lavatory 215, waste disposal intra EU 2 × 95, disbursement fee 358, agent 250, over 6 hrs 60, invoice processing 10, supplier stamp 2, stamp duty 2, limousine 410; laundry, storage, dish washing not entered. USER DECISIONS: ELL handling 1,516.85; parking ALEX and ELL 13.80 per hour, AFZ 15.90 (safe side); landing/departure kept at private tariff 10.61 per t (safe side); administrative fee 3.5%, disbursement fee 395 kept; push back 250 per movement tick with qty; waste disposal unit 95 with qty in basket; limousine 410 tick (bottom section); extra EU surcharge as handler row in Surcharge section (extraSc 14.68%, with 'apply'); supplier stamp and terminal operating extension under airport fees, without administrative fee (not in the 3.5% base on invoice); terminal operating extension tick (if extension occurs). By user decision: disbursement fee (395) as flat fee in Disbursement row (prices[type].disbFlat; shown as 'fee 395' with 3.5% administrative fee); invoice processing 10 tick (bottom section); push back in basket (with qty, default 1). FOURTH INVOICE 1.678 (31 Jul 2026; A6-FLH G450 34 t, LIRA–LIEO–LOWG, 21.07 12:49 – 24.07 12:46 local, 'parking hrs 70', 3 adults, intra-EU departure): parking 70 h × 9.28 = 649.74 (6.86 for a 16 h stay → hourly rate rises with long stays); intra-EU departure pax fee 48.84 and additional pax fee 6.50 (extra-EU 63.51 / 10; panel uses the higher), security 25.75 and bag 14.25 same; landing/departure 360.64; administrative fee 3.5%; standard handling 1,029.86; push back / tow bar 2 × 180 (G450; GLEX 250, panel 250); folder meteo 58.20; disbursement fee 379.50; agent 250, over 6 hrs 60, invoice processing 10, supplier stamp 2, stamp duty 2; storage 180, dish washing, laundry 443, taxi reservation, catering, limousine 195 not entered. By user decision parking to the safe side: ALX1·KBI, OWN, FLH 9.29 per hour; ALEX and ELL 18.68, AFZ 21.53 (with ratio 9.28 / 6.86 = 1.353). FIFTH INVOICE 1.613 (30 Jul 2026; A6-FLH, LFPB–LIEO–LIRI, 25.07, cancelled trip): only 'dedicated Sky agent one hour late CXX fee' 150 + stamp duty 2 = 152. By user decision tick row 'Late Cancellation Fee - Dedicated Sky Agent (1 h)' 150 in bottom section, all groups. SIXTH INVOICE 1.758 (5 Aug 2026; T7-AFZ GL7T 53 t, EGGW–LIEO–LFMN, 30.07 19:35 – 31.07 08:35 local, 'parking hrs 11', 1 adult, intra-EU departure): landing = departure 663.88 (12.53 per t), parking 11 h × 13.68 = 150.52, intra-EU pax fees, administrative fee 3.5%, standard handling 1,747.68, terminal operating extension 550, waste disposal extra EU 190, push back 2 × 250, disbursement fee 461, invoice processing 10, agent 250, over 6 hrs 60, supplier stamp 2, stamp duty 2; no extra EU surcharge (arrival from outside EU, departure intra-EU); limousine dispo 1,267.50 and crew 201.50, ice, catering, dish washing not entered. By user decision: AFZ handling 1,747.68, AFZ landing/departure 663.88; ALEX 488.32 and ELL 552.16 (linear between 34 t 360.64 and 53 t 663.88, safe side); waste disposal unit 190 (extra EU). CONTRACT (Sky Service handling agreement, article 5): 5.1 10% discount on standard handling (at article 2.1 airports; no discount on LIEO invoices — no discount in panel by user decision). 5.3.1 airport fee payment service at FBO airports (LIML/LIMC/LIPZ/LIPH/LIPX/LIRA/LIRN/LIRI/LIBD/LIBR): up to 300 € 7.95, 300–1,000 € 3%, over 1,000 € 3.5% — exactly the 'Commissione' on LIEO invoices (828.16 → 3% on 1.395). 5.3.2 at non-FBO airports 10% of third-party invoices — LIEO 'disbursement fee' 210 / 395 / 358 / 379.50 / 461 does not fit consistently (1.678 and 1.758 about 10%; 1.684 and 1.395 clearly higher, 1.138 lower; base unknown). By user decision flat fee removed in panel, disbursement 13.5% on airport fees (3.5% administrative + 10% disbursement fee); also applied to limousine (forceDisb). The 10% share charged on catering/laundry/limousine is deducted from the invoice together with catering in comparisons. Terminal operating extension 550 (user; appears linked to movements outside terminal hours, not stay: 1.684 21:11 arrival 400, 1.758 19:35 arrival / 08:35 departure 550). To ask Sky Services: disbursement fee base, administrative fee + disbursement fee on the same invoice, 10% handling discount. SEVENTH INVOICE 965 (16 Jun 2026; P4-BVY E135 25 t, LLBG–LIEO–OMDW, 08.06 03:45 – 11.06 17:47 local, 'parking hrs 84', no pax): landing/departure 184.50, parking 84 h 379.50 (4.52 per h), administrative fee 3% (748.50), standard handling overnight 831.50, terminal operating extension 2,800 (03:45 night arrival), lavatory 215, push back and towing 1 × 360, disbursement fee 496, invoice processing 10, agent 250, over 6 hrs 60, supplier stamp 2, stamp duty 2, limousine 461.50. LSGG.notes: DASSAULT AVIATION: invoices 23170 (P4-OWN, E35L 25 t, 31.07.2026), 23421 (A6-AFA, GL6T 46 t, 24.08.2026), 23427 and 23585 (T7-AFZ, GL7T 53 t, 31.08 and 02.09.2026). Handling E35L 800, GL6T 1,300, GL7T 2,800 CHF. PPR arrival + departure 50 + 50; PPR slot change 30 each (tick). Push & towing 365, lavatory 230, conveyor belt 196 (+15% admin). 'Administrational Fee' = 15% of airport fees + third-party services (conveyor, catering) → disbursement 15%. Swiss VAT 8.1% separately on invoice (not in panel). Airport fees (GVA, same at each handler): ATC E35L 326.50 / GL6T 500.30 / GL7T 552.50; landing per ton 8.80 below 50,001 kg (see the landing-per-ton paragraph at the end; 10.20 per ton applied until 17 Nov 2026), GL7T fixed 444.35 + 10.20 per ton above 50 t; indemnification 25% of landing; noise by noise class: class 5 (E35L, GL7T) 10, class 4 (GL6T) 40; ALX1·KBI and FLH 40 (earlier data); emissions 1.40 × the aircraft's engine emission value, and the figure stored in the panel is the resulting charge, not the value itself (E35L 5.05, GL6T 7.85, GL7T 14.55); per departing pax 27.90; airport slot fee 3 + 3. Landing/ATC for ALX1·KBI and FLH from earlier data (not verified by invoice); emissions unknown for these groups. Parking: per ton every started 24 h 7.50 CHF (Privatport invoices: E35L 25 t 24.7 h = 375, GL6T 46 t 15.4 h = 345, 45 t 27.9 h = 675); not charged by Dassault up to 1.5 h, first 2 h free assumed. Departing pax fee = departure tax 14.70 + security 13.20. Privatport handler prices from earlier data; airport fees updated with common tariff. SIGNATURE, first document check (17 Nov 2026): proforma G1166664 (TEST GLEX, private flight, LIML–LSGG–LOWW 24–28 Nov 2026, 7 pax) with the Geneva Airport fee simulation of 16 Nov 2026 behind it (GLEX 44,000 kg, noise class 4, emission value 5, wingspan C, cat 41). Handling 1,275, toilet 265, water 265 and pushback / towing 365 match the panel exactly, so Signature's prices are no longer 'earlier data' for the GLEX group. Changed: PPR request 115 (panel had 100, which is Dassault's 50 + 50; Signature charges one PPR fee, raised to 115 in every Signature group) and GPU GAP ground power unit 325 per hour (new, every Signature group). Signature bills the airport fees as one line 'Airport taxes / private flights' 2,560.80 and charges the 15% administration fee on that line only, which matches the panel's disbursement basis. The simulation confirms the whole GVA tariff independently: landing 387.20 = 44 t × 8.80, GABA indemnification 96.80 = 25% of landing, parking 1,320 = 4 started 24 h × 44 t × 7.50, emissions 7.00 = 1.40 × 5, departure tax 102.90 + security 92.40 = 7 × (14.70 + 13.20), de-icing ADIC 23.50, slot 3 + 3, noise class 4 = 40. Panel simulation for this flight with GPU excluded on both sides, after PPR was corrected to 115: panel 5,342.79 against 5,229.92, +112.87, the whole difference being the panel's 46 t against the aircraft's 44 t (+98.15 on the airport fees and +14.72 on the administration fee); every Signature handler line now matches the proforma exactly. PRIVATPORT (Swissport Executive): invoices 47033912 (A6-AFO, E35L 25 t, 22–23.06.2026), 47033794 (A6-AFC, GL6T 46 t, 28–29.05.2026), 47033352 (A6-AFD, GL6T 45 t, 26–27.03.2026). Handling by weight band: 16.6–24.9 t 600 (ALX1·KBI and OWN), 35–49.9 t 1,080 (May; 980 in March) — FLH 800 and AFZ 1,380 from earlier data. Night 50% handling (applied to 06:15 local departure; night window 22:00–07:00 assumed); manual 18% discount on May invoice (not in panel). Disbursement 10%: airport fees + third-party services (toilet 185, water 110/135, catering, limousine, taxi). TOILET AND WATER ROWS MERGED (user decision 17 Nov 2026): the separate 'Toilet Service (3. taraf, +disbursement)' and 'Water Service (3. taraf, +disbursement)' rows were removed and Privatport's third-party prices moved up into the ordinary Toilet Service and Water Service rows with the 10% disbursement already added — toilet 185 × 1.10 = 203.50 in every group, water 110 × 1.10 = 121 for CL60 and E35L and 135 × 1.10 = 148.50 for GLF4, GLEX and GL7T. Dassault (230 / 230) and Signature (265 / 265, GL7T 325 / 325) charge toilet and water as their own service with no administration fee on top, as the Dassault invoices and the Signature proforma show, so their figures were left as they are. PPR 100, pushback 395, GPU per hour 280, admin fee 60. Crew briefing 25, SRT water drain 650, limousine/taxi not in comparison. Airport fees on A6-AFO invoice charged incl. VAT (1,216.13; net 1,125.00); panel uses the net amount. DASSAULT QUOTATION 16 Nov 2026 (A6-AFE, Bombardier Global Express GLEX, MTOW 44,500 kg, operator ALEX JET; LIML–LSGG 24 Nov 14:45 UTC, LSGG–LOWW 28 Nov 13:30 UTC, 7 pax both ways; total 4,766.82 CHF excl. 8.1% VAT): handling category 6 1,300; PPR arrival runway slot 50 + departure runway slot 50; push & towing 365; departing passenger charge 27.90; noise class 4 40; airport slot fee 3 + 3; landing 8.80 per ton for MTOW below 50,001 kg (charged on 45 t = 396; above 50 t 10.20 per ton on the excess); indemnification 25% of landing; ATC 492.70; emissions 1.40 × 5.56 = 7.78; parking 1,350 = 4 started 24 h × 45 t × 7.50; administrational fee 15% on the airport fees only (2,610.28 × 0.15 = 391.54), which confirms the panel's disbursement basis. NEW ROW: de-icing station ADIC 23.50 (winter, MTOW below 75,000 kg), entered as a tick in all three handlers and all groups except GL5T, since airport fees are the same at every handler (user decision 17 Nov 2026). The GLEX group keeps 46 t (from the A6-AFA invoice) although this aircraft is 44,500 kg and was charged as 45 t, so panel landing, indemnification and parking stay slightly above the quotation (user decision 17 Nov 2026). Parking free hours are still an assumption (2 h); this quotation does not settle them, as 94 h 45 min gives 4 started periods either way. LANDING PER TON (user decision 17 Nov 2026, follow the latest document): the quotation states 8.80 per ton for every MTOW below 50,001 kg, so that rate now applies to all groups under 50 t and the earlier 10.20 per ton is dropped — CL60 22 t 193.60 (was 224.40), E35L 25 t 220 (was 255), GLF4 34 t 299.20 (was 300), GLEX 46 t 404.80 unchanged; GL7T 53 t keeps the above-50 t rule, flat 444.35 + 10.20 per ton on the excess = 474.95. Indemnification recalculated as 25% of the new landing in each group. Applied at all three handlers, landing being an airport fee. GL5T FILLED (user decision 17 Nov 2026): the Dassault quotation and the Signature proforma both carry the registration A6-AFE, which the panel puts in the GL5T group (Global 5000 / Gulfstream V · T7-ALEX, T7-ALEX1, T7-AFP, A6-AFE), even though the documents label the type GLEX; A6-AFC sits in the GLEX group. The user confirmed that A6-AFC and A6-AFE are priced the same, so the GL5T column, which was 'Basic Ground Handling not provided' at all three handlers, now carries the GLEX figures: Dassault handling 1,300, Privatport 1,080, Signature 1,275, with the common airport fees landing 404.80, indemnification 101.20, ATC 500.30, emissions 7.85, parking 345 per started 24 h and de-icing 23.50. The airport fees are the 46 t figures, so for the lighter tails in the GL5T group (T7-ALEX, T7-ALEX1, T7-AFP) they sit on the safe side. Note that Dassault invoice 23170 of 31 Jul 2026 charged the E35L 25 t at 10.20 per ton = 255, so the panel now sits below that invoice; either GVA changed the tariff between July and November or the two documents use different weight bands, to be checked with the next light-aircraft invoice.

LUKK.notes: MGH HANDLING (MGH Ground Handling S.R.L., Chișinău), EUR. Source: quote email 'Re: LUKK HANDLING QUOTE' (ops@mghandling.md; attachments: MGH Handling Proposal, Additional charges from 01 May 2026, RMO airport charges eff. 31 Jan 2025 — attachments not shared) and invoice 693 (25 Jul 2026; T7-ELL GLEX 44.452 t, EGGW–LUKK–EGLB, 23.07 13:34 arrival – 25.07 14:45 departure, 3 arriving pax, 0 departing) + Chișinău airport invoices 15263 and 15494. Quote: handling GL7T 930, GLEX 770, GLF4 770, E35L 570, CL60 570 (ALEX group empty); disbursement 10% on subcontracted services; push back / towing 130; GPU 70 / 30 min; toilet 70, water 45; VIP lounge adult arrival 83, departure 139 (incl. 10%), child 50%, infant free. Airport: landing & take-off per ton 8 (half on arrival and half on departure, 2 × 177.81), security per ton 7.5 (on departure), parking per ton daily 1.71 (2 days for 49 h), passenger fee per pax 9.7 (charged for arriving pax) — 10 for arrival and departure in panel. MGH invoice: basic handling 770 − 15% discount (115.50); airport charges commission 10%; VIP/express lounge arrival 3 × 62.50 + 10%; crew transportation on apron 3 × 30; crew/pax transport to/from hotel 2 × 70; landing approval support 50; printing & delivery of flight documents 25; catering 160 + 10%, HOTAC 166.67 + 15, napkin/tablecloth washing not entered; VAT 85.58 (breakdown unclear; not entered, excl. VAT rule). USER DECISIONS: handling at list price, 15% discount as a tick row in bottom section; passenger fee arrival and departure 10 (both handlers); VIP arrival 83, departure 139; GPU per hour 140 in basket; landing approval 50 and printing 25 in basket; crew transport apron 30 and hotel 70 tick with qty; parking per hour ton × 1.71 / 24 (both handlers). JETZ EXECUTIVE HANDLING from 14 October Excel (airport items shared with MGH). MGH second sources: Handling Proposal (included in basic handling: supervision, coordination, passenger handling, baggage, marshalling, chocks, cones, headset, 1 pax stair < 60 min, pax transfer 2 trips, crew transfer 1 trip, loading equipment, toilet 1 service, water 1 service; express terminal / VIP lounge up to 3 h arrival 85, departure 138; landing approval 50; disbursement 10% on all third-party payments), Additional charges list 01 May 2026 (excl. VAT; GPU 70/30 min, ASU 310, pax steps 75, bus 55 / minibus 30, tow/push-back 130, tow bar 50, toilet 70, water 45, city transfer 4 seats 55 / 5–8 seats 70 / 9–15 seats 75, printing 25, landing approval 50, catering ramp 30 etc.), RMO airport charges 31 Jan 2025 (landing & take-off 8 €/t non-scheduled, night 20% summer 20–06 LT, winter 18–07 LT; parking 1.71 €/t/24 h, first 3 h free on passenger flights; aviation security per departing pax 2.5, ferry (no departing pax) 7.5 €/t; passenger fee 9.7 per arriving and departing pax; follow-me 100 LVP/state). Invoice 786 (16 Aug 2026; A6-AFE GL6T 43.545 t, OERK–LUKK–ISL, 15.08 18:57 – 16.08 22:42 local, 4 arriving, 0 departing): airport 897.51 (night departure half landing × 1.2 = 209.02; parking 2 days; security 7.5/t), commission 10%, handling 770 − 15%, crew apron 1 × 30, hotel transfer 2 × 70, VIP arrival 4 × 62.61 + 10%, catering 200 + 20 and washing not entered, VAT 83.09. Times on airport invoices local. USER DECISIONS: MGH toilet and water 'Included'; VIP arrival 85, departure 139; ALEX group with GLEX prices (discount again a tick row in bottom section, not applied automatically); parking first 3 h free then every started 24 h ton × 1.71 (both handlers); night in Surcharge landing & take-off 20% arrival and departure separately (ton × 0.8), 18:00–07:00 all year; security two rows in basket: ferry ton × 7.5 (remove from 'in total' if departing pax) and 2.5 per departing pax. JETZ EXECUTIVE HANDLING quote email (ops@jetzhandling.com) + Standard Pricing Structure: handling GL7T/GLEX/GLF4 760, E35L/CL60 560 (list: 15–30 t 560, 30–50 t 760, above 50 t on request; GL7T 760 in email); included in handling marshalling, chocks, cones, 4 apron transfers (pax/crew); push back 170, GPU 75/30 min, toilet 50, water 50, ASU 300, pax stairs 69; VIP/GA terminal arrival 67, departure 113 (excl. disbursement); landing permit 30 (50 if less than 3 working days), documents printing 10, extra apron transfer 25, city transfer up to 8 persons per direction 45 + 20% VAT; disbursement 10% (may drop with SGHA or fuel); airport: landing and take-off 4 + 4 €/t, parking 1.71 €/t/24 h first 3 h free; 2% commission on remote payment (not entered); dish washing, laundry, refrigerator storage, meet & assist not entered. USER DECISIONS: ALEX group 760; VIP arrival 73.70, departure 124.30 (incl. 10%, comparable with MGH); GPU per hour 150 in basket; landing permit 50 and printing 10 in basket (landing approval / printing rows); extra apron transfer 25 and city transfer 54 tick (crew transport rows). JETZ CHARGE NOTE CN-A6AFE-17112026-0064 (issued 17 Nov 2026 08:42 UTC; A6-AFE 43.545 t, panel GL5T, 5 departing pax, night movements, no parking; EUR, 1 EUR = 20.1666 MDL): basic handling 760 (380 per movement), push back 170, lavatory 50, water 50, GPU 75 per 30 min, landing permit urgent 50, security 2.50 and passenger fee 9.70 per departing pax - all confirming the panel (passenger fee stays at the rounded 10 by earlier user decision). Airport fees 479.04 = landing and take-off 4.80 per tonne incl. the 20% night surcharge (2 x 209.02) + 5 x 9.70 + 5 x 2.50; disbursement 10% charged on third-party only, 47.90 on the airport fees plus 56.23 on the VAT-inclusive lounge = 104.13, which matches the panel's default airport-only disbursement base. USER DECISIONS (18 Nov 2026): GL5T airport fees moved from the 42 t basis to A6-AFE's 43.545 t at BOTH handlers (landing and take-off 348.36, night 34.84 per movement, parking 74.46 per day, ferry security 326.59) - the group had kept a 42 t basis from when A6-AFE sat in GLEX; Jetz express lounge departure lowered from 124.30 (quote 113 + 10%) to 104.97 (charge note 93.72 + 10% on the VAT-inclusive 112.46), arrival 73.70 left untouched as no arrival lounge was charged. Panel total for this flight 2,293.44 against the charge note's 2,206.77 excl. VAT (+86.67, mostly GPU entered per hour and the printing row). FCG OPS QUOTATION (17 Nov 2026; same flight as the Jetz charge note - A6-AFE 43.545 t rounded by FCG to 44 t, panel GL5T, EHAM-LUKK 20:00 UTC to LUKK-OERK 23:00 UTC, 0 arriving and 5 departing pax, 3 h on the ground; total 2,093.43): landing 44 x 8.32 = 366.08, parking 44 x 1.78 = 78.32, landing night surcharge 44 x 1.664 (20% of 8.32) = 73.22, pax tax 5 x 10.09, passenger security 5 x 2.50, basic ground handling 868, supervision on the apron 500, FCG disbursement 10% = 144.86 on handling plus airport fees but NOT on supervision, landing permit and communication charge free of charge. Third handler added by user decision; its type will be confirmed later. FCG's airport rates are 4% above the 2025 tariff the other two handlers use (8.32 vs 8.00, 1.78 vs 1.71, 10.09 vs 9.70) while the Jetz charge note of the very same day still billed the old rates, so by user decision each handler keeps the rates on its own documents; to be revisited when an MGH or Jetz invoice shows the new ones. FCG rounds the MTOW up to the whole tonne, so its GL5T rows use 44 t against 43.545 t at the other two. Handling 868 only for GL5T, other groups empty until their own quotations. New service row 'Supervision' (500, in basket); the allxs disbursement base excludes it automatically, exactly as the quotation computes it. Toilet, water and landing permit entered as 'Included' (first lavatory and water service included in ground handling, thereafter 50 and 65; permit and communication free). VIP lounge 100 arriving and 140 departing per pax (non-mandatory on the quotation and not charged on this flight); Senator VIP lounge 350 and the 50% technical-stop discount not entered; ferry aviation security left empty for FCG as it was not quoted. Night window confirmed by the quotation (summer 20:00-06:00, winter 18:00-07:00 LT); the panel keeps 18:00-07:00 all year. PARKING: the stay was exactly 3 h and FCG still charged a full ton-day although its own rule is 'free up to 3 hours'; by user decision the panel keeps the 3 free hours, which makes the panel 86.15 lower than this quotation (78.32 parking + 10% disbursement) and identical to the cent on every other line.

OBBI.notes: BLUE AVIATION (Blue Sky Aviation Services W.L.L., Manama), USD, excl. 10% VAT (on everything except coordination). Invoices and charge notes 1428 (T7-KBI CL60, 20 Jun 2025 Friday, turnaround, 6 + 6 pax), 1479 (P4-OWN E135, 8–11 Oct 2025, stay-over, 3 + 3 pax), 1685 (T7-AFP GLF5, 28 Apr 2026, technical, 1 + 1 pax); times UTC, Bahrain UTC+3. Blue's prices are the Hala Bahrain tariff × 2.6596 converted to USD and rounded up to 10 USD (Blue appears to buy ground handling from Hala): invoice values D turnaround 1,250, E stay-over 1,710, F technical 1,070, permit 120, pushback/towing 310, toilet/water/crew transport 140 match exactly. With user approval Blue's other handling prices from the Hala tariff with the same rule: turnaround D 1,250 / E 1,490 / F 1,810 / G 2,130 (Handling Fee); stay-over difference D 190 / E 220 / F 270 / G 270 (automatic if aircraft stays past midnight and longer than 2 h); technical D 800 / E 940 / F 1,070 / G 1,410 (tick, replaces handling). Landing ≤35 t 110, 35–50 t 160; parking per day ≤35 t 15, 35–50 t 24 (calendar day; panel 1 day up to 24 h, then +1 day per started 24 h); AFZ landing/parking not on documents. Passenger handling per pax each direction 140, landing permit 120 (with qty), coordination & service charges 400 (no admin). Toilet and water 140 in basket (one included in handling per Hala tariff; Blue charged it on 1479). Towing 310, crew transport 140 tick. Admin 5% on all items excl. coordination and crew transport. Surcharge 10% handling (Hala rule, safe side): night 22:00–06:00 local, Friday, public holiday; once per flight. 80 charged for Friday on 1428, panel on the safe side 125. HALA BAHRAIN: fee tariff (BHD), panel 1 BHD = 2.70 USD (USD payment rate on Bahrain Airport Company invoices; safe side by user decision). Basic handling by class (Technical / Turnaround / Stay-over): D 15–23 t 300 / 470 / 540 (ALX1·KBI), E 23–35 t 350 / 560 / 640 (OWN, FLH), F 35–50 t 400 / 680 / 780 (ALEX, ELL), G 50–75.9 t 530 / 800 / 900 (AFZ). Included in handling: supervision, marshalling, communications, chocks, one toilet, one water, one pushback, porter/baggage, aircraft transport, waste, flight plan, GD, meteo, crew briefing and lounge ('Included'). Surcharge 10%: landing/departure 19:00–03:00 UTC (22:00–06:00 local), Friday, public holiday. 50% for cancellation/delay with less than 3 h notice (not in panel). Additional services (BHD): passenger handling 50 (arrival or departure, per pax), landing permit 45, admin 20, GPU 75/h, ACU 90/h, ASU 90, conveyor 75 (basket); towing 115, crew transport 50 (tick). Other additional services (visa, headset, pax step, red carpet, mechanic etc.) not entered. Disbursement 15% on third-party payments (fuel 8%). Landing and parking not in the Hala fee tariff; parking taken from Blue's invoices as an airport fee, landing from the Hala quotation of 16 Nov 2026 (see below). Public holidays: Bahrain 2026 (Wego list) and 2027 estimated; for religious holidays the day before and after also listed on the safe side. Hala: toilet, water and pushback each once included in handling; extra use at unit price (toilet and water 50, pushback 115 BHD), with qty box in the row (qty 1 = included). Blue: one pushback included, extra use 310. Hala red carpet 100 BHD (per service) and flying carpet 70 BHD (per hour) tick. Bahrain Airport Company FBO (HBH = Hala) invoices 22772 (27 Sep 2026) and 22784 (28 Sep 2026), class E turnaround 560, passenger handling 50/pax, weekend (Friday) 10% = 56, landing 35, parking 5 BHD; no disbursement on landing and parking (BAC is the airport itself). Registration and times not on invoice. HALA LANDING (user decision 17 Nov 2026): the Hala estimate handling quotation of 16 Nov 2026 (T7-KBI CL60, 21,863 kg class D, 20 Nov 2026, turnaround) charges landing at cost at 1.4 BHD per ton (30.800 BHD for 22 t); this also matches the 35 BHD on the September BAC invoice for a 25 t class E aircraft, so the rate is confirmed by two documents. Landing is therefore calculated per group as 1.4 BHD per ton × 2.70 USD: CL60 22 t 83.16, E35L 25 t 94.50, GLF4 34 t 128.52, GL5T 42 t 158.76, GLEX 46 t 173.88, GL7T 53 t 200.34 (previously a flat 110, and 160 for 35–50 t, taken from Blue's prices), with 15% disbursement on top. Parking at Hala is still kept on the safe side with Blue's USD prices (15 per day, 35–50 t 24); 5 BHD on the Hala invoice, without disbursement (BAC is the airport itself). The same quotation also confirms, unchanged: basic handling turnaround class D 470 BHD, out-of-hours surcharge 10% for a Friday on the handling only, landing permit 45 BHD, passenger handling 50 BHD per departing pax, and one toilet, one water and one pushback included in basic handling. It charges no admin fee and no parking on a one-hour turnaround.

LGAV.notes: Documents (October 2026 ZIP): Signature quote 00437 (12 Aug 2026, per type), Universal Greece tariff (11 Aug 2026), Jetset T7-AFP proforma BSN-0036708 (1 Oct 2026). Prices excl. VAT; 24% VAT may apply in Greece (Jetset added VAT to handling and services; airport fees invoiced incl. VAT, e.g. GA fee 144 → 178.56). Landing, parking, GA fee and pax fees per airport tariff; Signature quote net figures used for all three handlers. Parking: first 95 min fixed, then hourly; free 00:00–04:59 local (panel does not calculate this). Signature: weekend/holiday/night 25%; admin 15%; type mapping (user): ALEX = GL5T, ALEX1 and AFP = GLEX, AFE and ELL group = GL6T. In panel ALEX group with GLEX figures (Signature 1,488, Universal 1,600, landing 241.70), ELL group with GL6T figures (Signature 1,785, Universal 1,900, landing 250.47). Landing 220.67 for ALEX, 250.47 for AFE; towing 250, ASU 175, parking permit first 2 days 110 € then 50 € per day; quote states a discount applied to handling. Universal: weekend/holiday 30%, night (22–06) 20%; disbursement 12%; 2 crew ramp transfers, 1 water service, conveyor and 1 h stairs included in handling; GPU 63 € per 15 min. Jetset: admin 12% on airport items (15 Nov 2026 quote; previously 7%, incl. catering). Jetset invoices BSN-0036403 (T7-AFP, 41 t, 15–16 Sep 2026, 24% VAT charged, airport items charged incl. VAT) and BSN-0036703 (T7-ALEX1, 42 t, 1 Oct 2026, VAT exempt art. 32): in ALEX group by user decision landing 232.88 and parking first 95 min 41.54 from the latest invoice (Jetset only; Signature and Universal kept with quote values). Jetset parking free every night 00:00–05:00 local (panel calculates). Pax ramp movement 30 each (tick, qty = movements), communication 25 tick. No 6% bank fee on invoices ('bank charges for sender'); earlier note removed. Additional 2,000 € if VIP lounge used. Custom fee not on documents, kept from earlier entry. Reduced mobility charge 0.55 per departing pax (at three handlers; deleted on 21 Oct and re-added under the safe-side rule). GOLDAIR HANDLING quotation email (14 Nov 2026, T7-AFZ, MTOW 48,535 kg on email; EUR, VAT extra): basic handling 1,520 (passenger and basic ramp services, stairs up to 1 h); GPU 165 per 30 min, towable belt conveyor 70 per 30 min, water 120, toilet 135, pax transportation within apron 85 per movement, crew transportation 70 per movement, ASU 220 per start, pushback 215; night 22:00–06:00 +35% and weekend / legal holidays +35% on basic handling; technical landing −40% (not entered by user decision); PPR arrangement 45, slot management 80 (both required 30 Mar–25 Oct), landing permission arrangement for non-EU carriers 195; airport and ATC fees per HCAA tariff (not quoted). USER DECISIONS (16 Nov 2026): handler GOLDAIR HANDLING (HANDLER); handling only in GL7T; equipment and services in all groups; GPU 330 per hour; conveyor belt and ASU new rows in basket (untick when not used; Signature ASU 175 from quote 00437); slot 80 in Slot / PPR row; landing permission arrangement 195 as handler service in basket (Goldair's own arrangement fee, not an authority charge; others not on their documents); airport fees same tariff values as the other handlers; no disbursement; custom fee empty, communication included; not verified (quote). Types from ops system (16 Nov 2026): Signature, Jetset, Universal FBO; Goldair HANDLER. SWISSPORT (Swissport Hellas Executive Aviation) quotation email (14 Nov 2026, T7-AFZ; EUR, VAT extra): basic handling 1,350 (incl. marshalling, chocks and cones, passenger and crew transportation within apron max 2 + 2 movements, passenger and ramp services, catering / fuel liaison, immigration and customs clearance incl. escort, MVT messages and communication); administrative duties 85; bus for crew 50 and bus for pax 60 per movement (2 free per turnaround); GPU 55 per 15 min; managing airport permissions without slots 70, airport permissions and slots 95; night 22:00–06:00 +25% and Saturdays / Sundays / legal or bank holidays +40% on basic handling; technical landing 70% of handling (not entered); disbursements at cost + 12%; landing / parking per AIA charges, passenger fee 3 per departing pax. USER DECISIONS (16 Nov 2026): handler SWISSPORT (SUPERVISING AGENT); handling only in GL7T; administrative fee new basket row; crew and pax bus included (2 per turnaround); GPU 220 per hour; Slot / PPR 95; communication and custom fee included; disbursement 12% on airport fees; not verified (quote). AIA aeronautical charges (Nov 2026 edition, effective 02 Nov 2024) checked 16 Nov 2026: landing 5.55 × MTOW (up to 55 t), parking remote stand first 95 min 0.99 × MTOW then 0.07 × MTOW per 15 min, free 24:00–05:00, GA fee 96 under 24 t / 144 under 55 t, security 5, PRM 0.55, ADF 3 per departing pax; panel values match; passenger terminal facility charge (16.65 / 19.95 per departing pax, collected on ticket) not in panel. SIGNATURE ATH email (14 Nov 2026, T7-AFZ): handling 2,100 + 25% weekend surcharge, GPU 230 per hour, toilet 105, water 105 per service; other costs to be advised by commercial department. USER DECISIONS (16 Nov 2026): GL7T handling 2,100 (previously 1,785 from quote 00437, safe side); GPU, toilet and water date-confirmed in all groups; other Signature items kept from quote 00437 until commercial department advises. JETSET quotation (15 Nov 2026, GL7T 52 t): basic handling 1,180 (incl. VIP passenger assistance, baggage handling, NOTAM, weather, toilet and water service); night 20%, weekend / holiday 25%; landing 287.49, parking first 90 min 51.28, GA fee 144, pax security 5, PRM 0.55, ADF 3; crew ramp 25 and pax ramp 30 per movement, GPU 120 per hour, towing 150, parking permission (if overnight) 100, slot booking / PPR 100, slot change / cancellation 40, communication 25, administration fee 12%. SIGNATURE quotation 00620 (16 Nov 2026, valid 90 days; ATH, GL7T 52,095 kg; EUR, 24% VAT where applicable): basic ground handling day 1,995 per flight (marshalling, weather, notams, VIP passenger service, baggage handling, steps 1 h, conveyor belt on arrival and departure; weekend / holidays / night +25%); landing 289.13, parking first 95 min 51.57, extra parking 14.59 per hour (free 00:00–04:59 LCL), GAF usage fee 500 per leg (over 30 pax or an athletic team), GA fee 144, pax security 5, A/P passenger tax 3, reduced mobility 0.55; ACU 370 per hour, towing 250 per operation, GPU 230 per hour, ASU 175 per start, parking permission 110 for the first 2 days then 50 per day, A/P slots 110, toilet 105, water 105, fast cabin cleaning 75, fuel coordination 50 (when fuel not through Signature), communication 30, high loader 250 per hour, push back 170, slot cancellation 110, steps 105 per hour, PPR 60, PPR cancellation 60, slot / PPR changes 60 per change, crew ramp 50 and pax ramp 50 per movement, administration fee 15%. Cancellation policy: 24–12 h before ETA 30% of handling, under 12 h 50% (not entered). USER DECISIONS (16 Nov 2026): GL7T handling 1,995 (no 'was' shown); Slot / PPR row split into A/P Slots (Signature 110) and PPR (60); new Towing row (Signature 250, Goldair 165 from its 14 Nov quote); new rows ACU (basket), fast cabin cleaning, steps, high loader, GAF usage fee and fuel coordination as tick rows; slot change / cancellation kept at 110 with the other cancellation amounts in the note; Signature prices date-confirmed 16 Nov 2026.

USER DECISIONS (9 Nov 2026): EUR, Greece, Europe/Athens; handler SIGNATURE, CL60 only; VAT not entered; 25% weekend (Sat–Sun), Greek 2026 public holidays and night (22:00–06:00 for now); parking if over 5 h every started 24 h from arrival 55; parking permission first 2 days 110 in basket, extra day 50 tick; pax fees per departing pax; handling, landing, slots, PPR, communication, toilet, water, ACU, GPU, ASU, towing, pushback in basket; administration fee 15% on all items (safe side); steps, high loader, cabin cleaning, ramp mvt, slot/PPR change, fuel coordination tick; cancellation fees not entered. UNIVERSAL AVIATION (Euro Aviation Greece S.A.) estimate LGRP for T7-ALX1 (CL60 21,863 kg; undated, received 11 Nov 2026; EUR; VAT 24% extra if applicable, not entered; CL60 only): standard services incl. chocks and cones, marshalling, passenger services, full baggage handling, flight following and messages, gen dec / manifests, 2 crew ramp transfers, 1 water service; handling & supervision 930, landing 132, parking up to 5 h free (after 5 h airport tariff as Signature, user decision), PPR 70, pax departure fee 3 and PRM / security fees 19.10 per departing pax, pax ramp transfer 55 per movement, pushback / towing 160 per movement, lavatory 80, GPU 63 per quarter hour (252 per hour); weekend / holiday +30% and night 22:00–06:00 +20% on handling-supervision (both applied if they coincide, safe side); third-party services recharged with 12% disbursement (airport fees, taxes, transportation, catering). Not quoted ('—'): slots, parking permission, ACU, ASU, steps, high loader, cabin cleaning, fuel coordination. GOLDAIR HANDLING (GABA Centralized, gaba.centralized@goldair-handling.gr) email 9 Nov 2026 for T7-ALX1 (CL60 21,863 kg), LGRP 16 Nov: basic handling 825 (pax and basic ramp services, pax stairs up to 1 h); extra: airport and ATC fees (no amounts; airport charges entered as for the other handlers, user decision), taxi / limousine / bus, apron transport, toilet, water, heating / ACU, GPU, ASU, cleaning, engineering GSE; GPU 165 per 30 min, towable belt 70 per 30 min, water 120, toilet 135, pax transport 85 and crew transport 70 per movement (tick), ASU 220 per start, pushback 215; night 22:00–06:00 +35% and weekend / legal holiday +35% on basic handling (both applied, tick to remove); technical landing −40% (not entered); PPR arrangement 45, landing permission for non-EU carriers 195 (airport fees), military airports 45 (n/a), slot management 80 per slot; slot and PPR required 30 Mar – 25 Oct only (untick in winter); apply at least 14 days before. No disbursement stated (0, to be asked). Not quoted ('—'): communication, ACU, towing, high loader, cabin cleaning. JETSET (Bespoke Handling, info@jetsetaviation.gr) quotation LGRP for Alex Jet, CL60 21,863 kg, 11 Nov 2026: basic ground handling 650 (incl. VIP passenger assistance, baggage handling, notam, weather, toilet and water service), night +20%, weekend / holiday +25% (both applied if they coincide); airport fees: landing 132, parking first 5 h free, 5–10 h 55, 10–24 h 110, each further day 220, pax security 2.80, reduced mobility 0.35, passenger imposed fee 15.50, airport development fee 3.00 per departing pax; extras: crew ramp 25 and pax ramp 30 per movement (tick), GPU 120 per hour, towing 150, parking permission 100 if overnight (new row, automatic only when the stay goes over midnight), slot booking / PPR 100 per flight (A/P slots row; PPR Included), slot change / cancellation 40, communication 25, administration fee 12% (entered as disbursement on the whole invoice, user decision). USER DECISIONS (11 Nov 2026): UNIVERSAL and GOLDAIR parking = Jetset's airport parking tariff (previously Signature's 55 per 24 h); Steps row removed for all handlers.
LGRP.verified: Entered from quotations, no invoice yet. SIGNATURE quotation 00611 (9 Nov 2026, CL60), UNIVERSAL AVIATION estimate (received 11 Nov 2026, CL60), JETSET quotation (11 Nov 2026, CL60), and GOLDAIR: email of 9 Nov 2026 for T7-ALX1 plus Pricelist E for Executive Flights of 19 Nov 2026, which fills all six groups. RHO is a Fraport station, so Goldair's ATH & Fraport column applies; the 825 already held for CL60 confirms it. Goldair handling follows the MTOW class, except T7-AFZ which is kept one class down at 1,520 by user decision of 19 Nov 2026 (its 53 t rounding would give class 7 at 3,165). Airport charges are entered in CL60 only for every handler; the other groups carry the handler's own flat fees. Invoices awaited.
